default: # PromptBase for Google Antigravity Search and use 300,000+ AI prompts and skills from [PromptBase](https://promptbase.com) without leaving Antigravity. Find prompts for game sprites, website images, video ads, marketing copy and more, then have your agent fill them in and use them in your project. ## What it adds - **The PromptBase MCP server** at `https://promptbase.com/mcp`, with tools to: - Search prompts and skills - View a listing's description, examples and the creator's rating - Open prompts you already own and fill in their variables - Download free prompts, or use your PromptBase Select downloads (the agent asks first) - Check your plan and list your prompts - **A `find-prompts` skill** that tells the agent when PromptBase can help and how to use it. Nothing is ever bought for you. For paid prompts, the agent gives you a link to check out on promptbase.com. ## Install ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/promptbasedev/antigravity-plugin ``` Then connect your PromptBase account: - **Antigravity App:** open Customizations → Installed and click **Authenticate** next to PromptBase under MCP Servers. - **Antigravity CLI:** run `/plugin`, expand `promptbase` under Installed and choose **Sign in**. Sign in to your PromptBase account (or create a free one), approve the connection, and paste the authorization code shown in your browser back into Antigravity. You can disconnect any time in your PromptBase account settings. ## Network and credentials - **Network:** the plugin only connects to the hosted MCP server at `https://promptbase.com/mcp`. It runs no local code, scripts or hooks. - **Credentials:** none are stored in this repository. Antigravity signs in with OAuth the first time it connects, and PromptBase issues it a token for your account. ## Links - Setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other agents: https://promptbase.com/agents - Privacy policy: https://promptbase.com/privacy - Support: hello@promptbase.com ## License The files in this repository are MIT licensed. The PromptBase service and its prompts are covered by the [PromptBase terms](https://promptbase.com/tandcs).
